title: FITWAY guarded desktop demo environment
summary: The demo is additive and isolated from production modules, but destructive Compose cleanup, credential handling, process ownership, secure localhost cookies, and time-relative seed data need explicit guards and live proof.
request: Implement the approved desktop-only synthetic demo environment for Public, Staff, and Owner using the real Postgres schema, authentication, services, APIs, and edge simulator.

in: Synthetic seed and real auth/service reuse
Live Public, Staff, and Owner verification
out: Production application behavior or schema changes
LAN, TLS, certificates, or firewall changes
Deployment, release, GitHub, screenshots, or PDF work

impact.evidence: Reset and clean remove a Compose volume; existing integration guards demonstrate the repository's fail-closed destructive-data policy.
AuthService hashes credentials and session cookies remain Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax; demo input must stay off disk and command lines.
The existing deterministic history generator and integration fixtures establish the accepted data semantics.
The new supervisor will own server, Vite, and simulator child processes and must not terminate unrelated reused PIDs.
Existing browser tests mock most requests; a new live spec is needed to prove the split-local origin and secure-cookie path.

risks.failure: Reset or clean targets a non-demo database or unrelated Docker resource.
risks.evidence: The operation is destructive, while the approved design fixes project, database, port, and path values.
risks.mitigation: Hard-code and independently validate the exact project, loopback URL, database name, and resolved local runtime path before every destructive call; test all refusal cases.
risks.rollback: No destructive call runs when a guard fails; successful cleanup affects only the disposable demo volume.

risks.failure: A raw Staff PIN or Owner password is committed, logged, stored, or exposed in a process command line.
risks.evidence: Credential material crosses the operator-to-seed boundary once during reset.
risks.mitigation: PowerShell secure prompts, environment-only child input, immediate environment clearing, no credential fields in profile/log output, and diff/log scans.
risks.rollback: Destroy the disposable database and local runtime directory; no real credential is in scope.

risks.failure: A stale PID file causes stop to terminate an unrelated local process.
risks.evidence: Windows can reuse PIDs after an unclean supervisor exit.
risks.mitigation: Record role markers and verify each live process command line before termination; refuse mismatches and remove only stale records for missing PIDs.
risks.rollback: Stop refuses ownership ambiguity; the user can close the foreground supervisor normally.

risks.failure: Secure session cookies do not persist across the localhost web/server split, blocking Staff or Owner login.
risks.evidence: Cookies are always Secure and the desktop demo uses HTTP localhost with exact-origin CORS.
risks.mitigation: Use localhost consistently, credentials-included requests, and a real Chromium login/session walkthrough; do not weaken cookie flags.
risks.rollback: Remove the demo harness; production cookie behavior is untouched.

risks.failure: Time-relative seed data is empty, stale, closed, or changes across same-day resets.
risks.evidence: Owner queries and freshness evaluate against wall clock while analytics rows use gym-local business days.
risks.mitigation: Anchor the profile to the current Asia/Riyadh business day, use a 24-hour synthetic schedule, fixed offsets and seed, and compare non-secret fingerprints across two resets.
risks.rollback: Reset recreates the complete disposable profile.

risks.failure: Docker or the Postgres image is unavailable on the local machine.
risks.evidence: Docker CLI exists, but the engine was inaccessible during discovery and no local Postgres service is installed.
risks.mitigation: Prepare/reset fail before writes with one actionable Docker Desktop prerequisite; never fall back to the existing remote env file.
risks.rollback: No repository or database mutation occurs when the prerequisite fails.

contracts.name: Database destruction boundary
contracts.mustPreserve: Only the named loopback demo Compose database and volume may be recreated or removed.
contracts.evidence: AGENTS.md and docs/WORKFLOW.md require exact disposable targets.
contracts.protection: Contract unit tests plus two reset/clean lifecycle runs.

contracts.name: Authentication and authorization
contracts.mustPreserve: Real hashed credentials, Secure HttpOnly cookies, server-side Staff/Owner guards, 401/403 semantics, and monitoring-only Staff.
contracts.evidence: FITWAY_PRODUCT.md, SPEC.md, AuthService, and authorization procedures.
contracts.protection: Focused auth tests and live browser/API denial checks.

contracts.name: Public privacy/data semantics
contracts.mustPreserve: Anonymous public output remains capacity-free and never exposes device, health, identity, or history.
contracts.protection: Existing payload tests plus live Public response assertions.

contracts.name: Historical analytics semantics
contracts.mustPreserve: UTC minutes, gym-local business day, settings snapshots, true zero, missing coverage, and deterministic generation.
contracts.evidence: History generator and Phase 9 integration tests.
contracts.protection: Seed unit tests, fingerprint comparison, and Owner live assertions.

plan.change: Add guarded Compose/operator/profile tooling and focused unit tests.
plan.validation: Focused Vitest, type checks, repository invariants, and diff hygiene.

plan.change: Add and run the unmocked desktop browser walkthrough and lifecycle proof.
plan.validation: Two resets, live Playwright, stop/restart, status, and scoped clean.

plan.change: Freeze, independently review, integrate, and mark the milestone DONE.
plan.validation: verify:fast, focused suites, candidate freeze, independent review, and clean canonical status.
plan.rollback: Revert final integration commits and run demo clean.
